description:
Verso: Looks like a book list. Headed: "belonging to Natan b. Avraham." Including an arrangement of Seliḥot; the liturgy for the taking out of the Torah; a text listing all of the leaders of Israel from Moshe until Ṣedaqyahu and the lineage of the Davidites from Adam until Shelomo the Exilarch; and the names of the women from Eve until the mother of Avraham Avinu; and something from a book of interpretation of dreams. 

Recto: Liturgy for public fast days. Siddur of Saʿadya Gaon. (Information from CUDL.)
